alt: 其他人正投零錢幫助有需要的人，一名男子卻把裝滿錢的皮夾緊緊抱在胸前，不肯拿出任何一枚。
scene_prompt: 一毛不拔 means extreme stinginess, refusing even the tiniest contribution despite having plenty. At a modern neighborhood charity table, two ordinary adults each happily put a single plain coin into a transparent donation jar with no label. A third adult stands prominently in foreground clutching a very full open brown wallet TIGHTLY against his chest with both hands, shielding every coin and turning away with a stubborn miserly expression. He clearly has ample money and refuses to share even one small coin. Nearby table has neatly packed food parcels for people in need. No readable banknotes, currencies, brand marks or text. Gently humorous, do not portray poverty as the reason for refusal.
